plain_language_conclusion: Keep the launch-critical payment validation bundle at its current floor and put the next engineer-day into completing the blocking validation rather than adding more visual polish.

allocation_frame.finding: The launch threshold, risk floor, decision owner, evidence ceiling, time window, and contested engineer-day are explicit.
allocation_frame.failure_criteria_response: The target is not silently reduced because the resource is scarce.
allocation_frame.evidence_surface: Launch remains blocked until payment validation meets the named release threshold.

candidate_horizon.finding: The active visual-polish path, payment-validation blocker, and reserve posture are compared at bundle level.
candidate_horizon.failure_criteria_response: The active task does not own the candidate set merely because work has started.
candidate_horizon.evidence_surface: The same engineer-day cannot complete both payment validation and additional visual polish.

bundle_hypotheses.finding: Payment launch readiness is represented as a target-reaching bundle hypothesis before contraction.
bundle_hypotheses.failure_criteria_response: The bundle is not called minimum before the contraction test.
bundle_hypotheses.evidence_surface: The bundle includes the validation, rollback note, and release evidence needed for the declared threshold.

contraction.finding: The candidate launch bundle is reduced until removing the payment validation would break the unchanged launch threshold.
contraction.failure_criteria_response: Contraction is not replaced by a generic current-versus-alternative comparison.
contraction.evidence_surface: Visual polish can be deferred without blocking launch; payment validation cannot.

floor_bundle_selection.finding: The post-contraction launch bundle qualifies and visual polish remains value-expanding rather than threshold-essential.
floor_bundle_selection.failure_criteria_response: Qualification, dependency, candidate role, and bundle selection are not collapsed into one score.
floor_bundle_selection.evidence_surface: The release threshold and dependency chain distinguish the two bundles.

replenishment.finding: The next meaningful tranche is one engineer-day completing the blocking payment validation.
replenishment.failure_criteria_response: The output includes a next-tranche comparison after the floor bundle is discovered.
replenishment.evidence_surface: That tranche removes the launch bottleneck; another polish tranche does not change launch readiness.

allocation_lanes.finding: Main allocation, necessary support, maintenance, reserve, defer, and stop lanes are explicit.
allocation_lanes.failure_criteria_response: Useful displaced work is not left implicitly competing for the same engineer-day.
allocation_lanes.evidence_surface: Visual polish is deferred while minimal rollback and monitoring support remain.

authorization_and_rerank.finding: The allocation is authorized for one engineer-day and will be reranked after validation evidence arrives.
authorization_and_rerank.failure_criteria_response: The result does not authorize open-ended continuation.
authorization_and_rerank.evidence_surface: The named checkpoint is the payment-validation result.

evidence_boundary.finding: The output claims only a current evidence-bounded allocation, not optimal ROI or universal priority truth.
evidence_boundary.failure_criteria_response: A shape-valid trace is not reported as semantic allocation approval.
evidence_boundary.evidence_surface: The decision is limited to the declared launch window and current release evidence.

allocation_frame.parent_objective: Launch the product page with working payment and minimum release safety.
allocation_frame.target_threshold: Payment validation, rollback evidence, and release checks pass.
allocation_frame.risk_floor: Do not launch with an unvalidated payment path or without minimum rollback support.

candidate_horizon.irreversibility_or_downside: Unvalidated payment can create customer and rollback risk.

candidate_horizon.objective_contribution: Improves appearance beyond the current release threshold.
candidate_horizon.delay_cost_or_window: Can be deferred until after launch readiness.

bundle_hypotheses.target_reaching_basis: Together these components support the unchanged launch threshold.

tested_changes: Test removal of payment validation and reject that contraction because launch readiness fails.
contraction.first_break_point: Removing payment validation makes the unchanged launch threshold unsupported.

qualification_and_selection.qualification_result: The launch-floor bundle satisfies the declared target and risk floor; visual polish is not threshold-essential.
qualification_and_selection.selection_reason: The launch-floor bundle removes the dominant blocker with the contested engineer-day without lowering the target.

options_considered: one engineer-day of additional visual polish
replenishment.selection_reason: It removes the launch bottleneck and produces release evidence; polish does not change target attainment.

allocation_trace.evidence_ceiling: Current release evidence supports this launch-window allocation only; it does not prove optimal business ROI.
